//: Two services on purpose — the defect is only reachable on the deployable that does not host the claim's aggregate.
title: id-typed user claim naming an aggregate the deployable does NOT host
note: The system-wide `user { agentId: Agent id? }` shape is emitted on every `auth: required` deployable, but the ids module declared only the hosted aggregates' brands (+ foreign event/workflow ids), so `payments` named an `AgentId` nothing emitted: node TS2694, python ImportError at boot, java/.NET missing symbol.  The claim shape is now a foreign-id source in `src/ir/util/foreign-ids.ts`.

apiCaller.e2eLess: COMPILE-TIER WITNESS — the FOREIGN twin (claims eval D6): the same `agentId: Agent id?` claim on a deployable (`payments`) that does NOT host `Agent`, so its ids module never declared the brand its `User` names (node TS2694, python ImportError at boot, java/.NET missing symbol).  The defect is the existence of a declaration, which the compile tier reads directly; no route of the fixture reads the claim.  Reasoned permanent entry.
